name: Bound by Night
source:
Bound by Night is an adult Visual Novel set in the modern world with supernatural elements. It includes six core characters as well as five patron-sponsored characters, all of whom are romanceable. The story combines elements of the the psychological horror and erotic genres, with explicit sex scenes between men and dominant/submissive relationships that can evolve over the course of the story.

Bound by Night has its own mythology around the supernatural elements. It takes place in a world just like ours -- without magic -- but in which vampires and werewolves exist. Over the course of the story, the main character will learn how these creatures came to be and how much more dangerous they could become.

[From [url=https://boundbynight.itch.io/bbn-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Bound by Night》是一部以现代世界为背景、带有超自然元素的成人视觉小说。它包括六个核心角色以及五个赞助人赞助的角色，他们都是浪漫的。这个故事结合了心理恐怖和色情类型的元素，男性之间露骨的性爱场景以及随着故事的发展而演变的主导/顺从关系。

Bound by Night有自己的关于超自然元素的神话。它发生在一个像我们的世界一样的世界——没有魔法——但存在吸血鬼和狼人。在故事的过程中，主角将了解到这些生物是如何形成的，以及它们会变得多么危险。

[来自[url=https://boundbynight.itch.io/bbn-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
